claims.evidence: Photos show a keyboard but not its origin, brand, or quality.
Report lists key and button function as not shown.
Report lists adapter inclusion as not shown.
Photos do not show provenance or purchase location.
Report lists key function as not shown.

risks.proof: Video of the keyboard powering on and the display or lights activating
Video of every key being pressed and producing sound
Video of audio playing through the built-in speakers
Video of the screen showing information

risks.risk: Buttons and knobs do not work
risks.proof: Video of buttons and knobs being adjusted

risks.risk: Power adapter or cable is missing
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter and cable with the keyboard
Photo of any stand or bench included
Close-up photos of ports, key underside, and interior for corrosion or repair marks
risks.if_unproven: as possibly water damaged or repaired

risks.risk: USB or MIDI connectivity does not work
risks.proof: Video of USB or MIDI connection to a device

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on
Video of all keys, buttons, knobs, and speakers working
Photo of the power adapter and cable
Photo of any stand or bench
Close-up photos for water damage or repairs
response.reason: The witness identifies an electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working; functionality and origin claims are unverifiable remotely and would require proof to raise the value.
